new_learnings.text: Panic regime with green indices is the most dangerous tape for momentum: 50 large-cap tech names lift the index while 3,727 stocks decline. Breadth (0.46:1) tells the real story — buying into narrowing leadership invites whipsaw on rotation reversal.
new_learnings.mechanism: Index-level gains driven by <5% of stocks create a false signal of market health. When breadth diverges this sharply from indices, the market is effectively distributing — weak hands chase the index, strong hands sell the majority.

new_learnings.text: MA-distance Rule 2b correctly blocks the most tempting FOMO candidates: 芯碁微装(dist_ma5=11.1%), 联瑞新材(21.2%), 华锡有色(12.6%), 兴森科技(8.8%) — all in hot sectors with strong narratives, all overextended. These are precisely the stocks V1 would have bought at the top.
new_learnings.mechanism: Hot sectors create narrative gravity that overrides price discipline. The MA-distance rule acts as a mechanical circuit breaker that cannot be overridden by sector enthusiasm.

new_learnings.text: 华峰测控(688200) pullback to near MA10 in #4 半导体 sector is the cleanest setup in the pool: RPS120=94.01% sweet spot, dist_ma10=-5.4%, fundamentals strong (rev +51%, profit +82%), 大股东减持 event is known and priced. Top candidate when regime clears.
new_learnings.mechanism: A known negative catalyst (大股东询价转让) that has already executed at a fixed price removes uncertainty — the overhang is quantified and absorbed. Combined with pullback to technical support in a hot sector, this creates an asymmetric entry.

new_learnings.text: Tech/consumer divergence is structural, not rotational: 通信设备 +207% 12-month vs 白酒 -26%. Money is reallocating from consumption to AI/productivity, not rotating between them. This means consumer-sector bargains are value traps, not rotation plays.
new_learnings.mechanism: When the divergence is driven by fundamental re-rating (AI productivity vs consumption stagnation) rather than sentiment rotation, mean-reversion strategies fail. The trend is the trend until the fundamental driver changes.

market_summary: PANIC REGIME — Hard block on new longs. Indices green (上证+0.22%, 深证+0.73%, 创业板+1.65%, 科创50+2.11%) but breadth catastrophic at 0.46:1 (1713↑/3727↓). 31跌停 vs 82涨停. Narrow tech leadership masking broad-based selling — a handful of large-cap 通信/半导体 names are lifting indices while ~68% of stocks decline. IV mixed: 科创50 elevated at 56.3% rank (volatility premium in tech), broad market IV low-moderate. 通信设备(+5.46%) and 半导体(+3.35%) persist as leaders; consumer/cyclical sectors in structural decline. No active positions; cash 100%. Waiting for breadth to clear 1.5:1 gate before deploying.
